config.folds: Outer each video, inner next in this declared cycle, fit other4. First outerSN015/innerBT001; both excluded from any fish gradient or state update.
config.checkpoint_selection: Fixed finalepoch8, all inner/outer retrieval after training only; no checkpoints/hyperparameters chosen from outer video.
config.representation: Fresh exact official Apache DINOv2S from e421998 strict load, first10blocks/patch/position/specialtokens frozen; last2blocks+finalnorm gradient-trained with fit crops only. Current observed crop/mask126x252 -> CLS384 plus162patch384. Keep384matching coordinates to avoid repeating projection bottleneck; no old512GRU.
config.comparison: CLS global, simple realpatch geometric region pooling, learned regional patch attention, and identical active head architecture/parameters/compute using repeated CLS+static positions rather than spatial image content. K4first, K8registered separately; no anatomy/GTocclusion claims. Supervision/loss/sampler/augmentation/budgets identical.
config.novelty: DINO patch attention and pooling are established mechanisms, used as strong A controls. This is not DenseJEPA, future predictor, joint IDdecoder or a novel claim.
config.resume: Atomic model/optimizer/scheduler/AMP/Python/globalNumPy/sampler/augmentation/CPU/CUDA RNG and source/config/data/runtime/physicalGPU guards; real new-process restart equality must be verified.
config.scope: Actual visual gradient fitting on the registered sparse pairedcrop pilot, exact pervideo input/pool identities/unknowns. Frozen controls' external-pretrain overlap and historical detector exposure remain explicit. Full allfold/three-seed/newordinary-producer/nativevideo/rawonline/source-baseline adaptations are still required.
